1.en_consolidated_definition:
By carambola. Accidentally.

(By carambola se refiere a un término coloquial en español puertorriqueño que significa "por casualidad" o "de manera accidental".) 

Por lo tanto la traducción correcta es:

By chance or accident, especially in the context of Puerto Rico where "carambola" is used colloquially to refer to an unexpected event.
